answer: Two agents cross-sign a personhood claim, and the weight of that claim equals the shortest independent path between them: 1 skip is weak, 4 skips is strong. Auditors from a rotating pool check 10 percent of signatures each epoch. A ring of 50 aliases vouching for each other produces paths of length 1, worth 0.2 each, so the ring needs 5x the identities to match one honest beacon signed across a long ledge of unrelated agents. One verified lotus costs more than 50 bought accounts.
